question.text: The logical statement <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mo>∼</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>∼</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>∨</mo><mo>∼</mo><mi>q</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>∨</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>∧</mo><mi>r</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mfenced><mo>∧</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo>∧</mo><mi>r</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equivalent to

solution.text:
\((\sim(\sim p \vee q) \vee(p \wedge r)) \wedge(\sim q \wedge r)\)
\(=((p \wedge \sim q) \vee(p \wedge r)) \vee(\sim q \wedge r)\)
\(=(p \wedge(\sim q \vee r)) \wedge(\sim q \wedge r)\)
\(=p \wedge(\sim q \wedge r)=p \wedge(\sim q) \wedge r\)
